inherited_authority.no_data_authority_work_redone: this contract binds to the certified authorities; it does not re-derive or re-adjudicate dataset authority

funding_time_le_decision_time.rule: for every decision at T, all funding observations used satisfy funding_time_ms <= T

funding_availability_time_le_decision_ti.rule: availability_time_ms <= T; availability_time_ms == funding_time_ms == settlement_time_ms, therefore the current settlement is usable at T and no future settlement is
funding_availability_time_le_decision_ti.next_funding_time_excluded: next_funding_time_ms is a derived field and MUST NEVER be read as an observation

oi_time_le_decision_time.rule: every OI observation satisfies timestamp_ms <= T; OI observations strictly after T are invisible

price_time_le_decision_time.rule: only COMPLETED 1h bars inform a decision at T: bar_open_time + 3600000 <= T; the decision hour's own close is NOT used

completed_windows_only.rule: no partial/forming window may be used for any feature; the entry bar (which is by construction after T) is never used to compute the signal

future_mutation_invariance.rule: mutating any observation with timestamp strictly AFTER T cannot change ELIGIBILITY_AT_T, FEATURE_STATE_AT_T or SIGNAL_INPUT_AT_T
future_mutation_invariance.test: FUTURE_MUTATION_AFTER_T (non-vacuous baseline required: the un-mutated state must be identical to the original recomputation)

past_eligible_mutation_detection.rule: mutating a PAST ELIGIBLE observation (inside the trailing 60d funding window at T, or the OI now/reference observation of an active decision) MUST change FEATURE_STATE_AT_T, so no stale caching or retroactive revision can silently freeze a decision

archive_completeness_non_retroactivity.rule: the OI day-validity ledger (OI_ARCHIVE_DAY_VALIDITY_LEDGER_V2.jsonl) is FORENSIC EVIDENCE ONLY and MUST NOT control historical decision eligibility; eligibility is timestamp-scoped causal completeness at T. A later-arriving archive day cannot retroactively invalidate or validate a historical decision.
archive_completeness_non_retroactivity.enforced_by: V2 causal reader contract (PIT-CAUSALITY-REPAIR-01); the ledger is never queried on a trading path

no_conflicting_duplicate.rule: a conflicting duplicate timestamp <= T fails the decision closed (NO_SIGNAL / INVALID) rather than silently selecting one row
no_conflicting_duplicate.funding_duplicate_status: 0 conflicting duplicates in the certified funding authority

determinism_of_decision_chain.rule: for a fixed authority, the decision chain (eligibility -> features -> signal) is a pure deterministic function of T; no RNG, no wall-clock, no environment dependency
determinism_of_decision_chain.rng_in_decision_chain: NONE (RNG appears only in the frozen statistical/resampling gates, which are post-signal and seed-fixed)

stale_data_policy.rule: funding: the decision settlement must exist exactly at T (no carry-forward of an older settlement as if it were new); OI: staleness <= 600s for both oi_now and oi_reference
stale_data_policy.violation_outcome: NO_SIGNAL (fail-closed), with the frozen reason code

missing_data_policy.rule: absent required input => NO_SIGNAL / INVALID per the frozen precedence; never interpolated, forward-filled or synthesized

data_time_contract.price: data_time = bar_open_time (the bar is usable only once completed at bar_open_time + 3600000)

violation_semantics.NO_SIGNAL: a decision with no admissible trade (reason code recorded)
violation_semantics.INVALID: a decision whose required inputs cannot be trusted (conflicting duplicate, corrupt row); treated as NO_SIGNAL for trade emission and counted separately in the decision ledger

prohibited_reads: any OI row with timestamp_ms > T
any price bar with bar_open_time + 3600000 > T
any bar O/H/L/C of the entry or exit bar for signal construction
the OI day-validity ledger as a decision gate
any third-party reconstruction of funding or OI
